ns2:section.sectionText: Community Stewardship through Environmental Education In this service learning course, visit area schools (grades 5-10) to teach students about the impacts of introduced species using science-based information. Also, facilitate student-developed community stewardship projects to help reduce the spread of aquatic invaders. Guest scientists and the Nab the Aquatic Invader! Web site (www.sgnis.org/kids) will serve as the foundation for the course. Section CS8 will be at Edison Middle School 2:00-2:40 on Mondays and Wednesdays. Students are responsible for their own transportation. NO PREREQUISITES REQUIRED. 2 hours. No field trip fee.
